n7e36bd704e.headline: National Bank: Rate Regulation Operations Are Not a Tool for Providing Loans
n7e36bd704e.summary: The National Bank of Kazakhstan linked recent money market rate rises to tax week and clarified that rate regulation operations are not tools for providing loans.
n7e36bd704e.why: Monetary policy operations impact short-term interest rates and liquidity conditions in Kazakhstan's financial markets.
